name: Evermere
subtitle: Day One
author: Luminati
description: The epilogue of The Bells of Evermere: Evermere at dawn, the first morning of spring — the great Thaw over the town, the lake breaking, the fifth toll. Generated by tools/make-bells-of-evermere.mjs.

objects.name: Agathe's Bakery
text: Warm through the door: cinnamon, and something burning slightly.

objects.name: The Weaver's House
text: A loom clacks inside, slow and patient. Whatever it is, it is very long by now.

objects.name: The Silent Bell
text: Through the door: a fiddle, badly tuned, and somebody laughing anyway.

objects.name: The Moot Hall
text: A notice on the door: NO MEETING THIS WEEK. Under it, older: NO MEETING THIS WEEK.

objects.name: Old Nettle's House
text: Somebody inside is arguing with a kettle, and winning.

objects.name: The Cooper's House
text: Barrels stacked to the rafters. Years of barrels, and nothing to put in them.

objects.name: The Chapel of the Bells
text: The chapel is cold. Seven rows of candles, all of them lit.
The well has been a solid block of ice since that night. Somebody has carved a face in it.

objects.label: Enter
locked: Not yet. Not till I know what I'm going for.

objects.label: Enter
locked: The gorge road. Seven winters of drift.

objects.label: Enter
locked: The east road. Not before the Bell of Tides.

objects.label: Enter
locked: The Frost Gate. Seven winters thick.

objects.speaker: Signpost
text: ← The Blossomwood. The Bell of Waking.

objects.speaker: Signpost
text: ↓ The gorge road to Saltcombe. The Bell of Tides.

objects.speaker: Signpost
text: → Amberfield, across the fields. The Bell of Harvest.

objects.speaker: Day board
text: In chalk: THE WEST BELL RANG. AND THE SOUTH ONE. EAST TOO!!!

objects.speaker: Day board
text: The 2,578 has been rubbed out with a mitten. Under it, in a child's round hand: SPRING!!!

objects.name: Tin
talk: : Empty armour, standing where it chose to stand. Blossom has settled in its open helm. #line:5C9CC45F3F6753C65C3667B99FD6EE2A

objects.name: Osmund
objects.title: The Bellkeeper
talk: if ev-sp-grave
Osmund: When you're ready, sparrow. I've waited seven years. I can wait a little longer. #line:55DDAD84177B4A0DD947FF11B66FFE61
stop
Osmund: Go and see them all. Then come and find me with your mother. #line:A35B690E123986136AC7631FB5B917D0

objects.name: Dilly
talk: once ev-sp-dilly-crown
Dilly: Look! A crown of everything! A blossom, a shell, a red leaf — and a snowdrop, so winter doesn't feel left out. #line:D404E3B636D6A135372C009549CF1FC8
player: It suits you. #line:E984A15A67FFD2403F4F49DB028F156F
Dilly: I know. #line:586A20A9A69FA2AE2E81316E1DAB0B5B
quest dilly done
stop
cycle ev-sp-dilly
* Dilly: The grass is GREEN. Gran didn't make it up. Gran didn't make ANY of it up. #line:21498CED57480762DB91B425B1709CC1
* Dilly: I gave the tin knight flowers. It didn't say thank you, but it never says anything. #line:65B23B2E5D6952516B4BB5C7C0D4822B

objects.name: Agathe
objects.title: The Baker
talk: once ev-sp-agathe-cake
Agathe: All those mornings of practice. It's perfect. Somebody eat it before I cry. #line:9DA4B5E39A7EF5A88A86E4EB39724E35
player: …It's very good. #line:CCC14D19110C7F59E2265EBC29E06B82
Agathe: Oh, I'm crying anyway. #line:E3773BBE7CE3A524AAD30298DA89DCC0
stop
Agathe: A Waking Cake for the first morning. And tomorrow I shall bake something else entirely. I don't know what. Isn't it marvellous? #line:6A6241E3C0ABA79A129D59744C6D1121

objects.name: Old Nettle
talk: once ev-sp-nettle
Old Nettle: Told you it'd turn. #line:D75A2671AFE331FEBE0CFC12EE85E33F
stop
Old Nettle: The lake's full of fish that think it's still the night it froze. I'll not tell them if you won't. #line:893752004B8B34A915A9DC57882D9500

objects.name: Gran Maud
objects.title: Dilly's Gran
talk: Gran Maud: Seven years she asked me what green smelled like. I said wait. I'm glad I said wait. #line:DAF04985981766DDD055A12B007999DF

objects.name: Cobb
objects.title: The Lamplighter
talk: Cobb: First morning I've not had to light a lamp. I don't know what to do with my hands. #line:CFB32D4804DE00323E42DF50CC76D4D4

objects.name: Gilly
talk: Gilly: The ice went! I was standing on it! Well — near it. Well — I saw it. #line:0E9FB47A9A14C64F1AA0B859EDDFCFAB

objects.name: Bryn
objects.title: The Miller
talk: Bryn: Listen. Hear that creak? She's turning. She's turning! #line:BDCB9E047375BA1BCBA72655E3FF703A

objects.name: Osric
objects.title: The Gate Watch
talk: Osric: Wall's gone, sun's up, nothing to watch. Might take up fishing. Nettle says she'll teach me. Heaven help me. #line:047D5C57C1AB7BD09C3AD4E228F75AEC

objects.name: Jory
objects.title: Of the Patience
talk: cycle ev-sp-jory
* Jory: I came up to see the spring for myself. Wenna says I owe her for the cart. #line:809169588BB3D3371E0DE3034F34D3D5
* Jory: I asked after Mabli Price all morning. Married a cooper. Three children. Seven years, and I still had a ribbon for her in my pocket. #line:EBD9CDE2ED88AE432127AF31F2910307
